description: Turn a business brief plus optional reference ids into a reference-backed build direction. Returns the chosen StandOut direction, matching public-product references, relevant flow patterns, a synthesized build plan, implementation lock, and next tool calls. Use when you want the agent to build from evidence instead of vibes.

direction.description: Optional StandOut direction id to force, e.g. terminal-grade

industry.description: Industry or category, e.g. developer tool, restaurant, law firm

query.description: Optional reference search query. Defaults to business/industry/vibe/audience

reference_ids.description: Optional exact reference ids from search_references

vibe.description: Desired feel, e.g. premium, technical, warm, playful

name: synthesize_direction_from_references
